description: This file defines a protocol `LocationServiceCommon` with extension methods for configuring location services and requesting the current location, along with a support enum `LocationServiceSupport` providing utility functions related to location authorization and requesting location asynchronously.

methods.name: configureLocationManager
methods.description: Configures the CLLocationManager by setting its delegate and desired accuracy.

methods.name: authorizationStatus
methods.description: Returns the current authorization status from CLLocationManager.

methods.name: accuracyAuthorization
methods.description: Returns the accuracy authorization, considering API availability.

methods.name: requestLocationOnce
methods.description: Asynchronously requests a single location update and returns the CLLocation.

methods.name: accuracyAuthorization
methods.description: Provides the accuracy authorization, with support for iOS 14+ and fallback.

methods.name: requestLocation
methods.description: Asynchronously requests location updates, setting a continuation for handling the result.
